jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – AI Enablement
jobs.snippet: Canva AI Enablement team is hiring a Senior MLE to provide critical solution expertise to researchers and AI builders, helping them navigate platform capabilities and accelerate from experimentation to production. Expertise in ML systems including evaluations, training, inference, data pipelines required.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Inference Platform
jobs.snippet: Join Canva's Inference Platform team to build and improve systems that serve machine learning models in production at massive scale. Focus on implementing production-grade serving systems and improving latency, throughput, and reliability.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Inspire & Create
jobs.snippet: Canva is hiring a Senior MLE for the Inspire & Create team with deep expertise in Generative AI including LLMs, diffusion models, and prompt engineering. Work on next-generation creative AI features used by millions globally.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Content ML
jobs.snippet: The Content ML team at Canva is focused on empowering users with the safest and highest quality content at scale. Seeking a Senior MLE to develop AI-based solutions for content moderation and quality ranking across Canva's vast content library.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Integrations
jobs.snippet: Canva Integrations team is seeking a Senior MLE to build ML-powered integrations connecting Canva to the broader design and productivity ecosystem. Work on recommendation models, smart auto-fill, and AI-driven UX improvements for third-party app connections.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist – People Analytics
jobs.snippet: Canva is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the People Analytics team (remote across ANZ). Use machine learning and statistical modelling to provide insights on talent, workforce planning, and employee engagement at Canva's global scale.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist – Product, Features & Growth
jobs.snippet: Join Canva's Product Data Science team to drive product growth through rigorous experimentation, advanced modelling, and actionable insights. Open to remote across ANZ. Deep expertise in A/B testing, causal inference, and Python/SQL required.

jobs.title: AI Prototyping Analyst | KPMG Futures
jobs.snippet: KPMG Futures is hiring an AI Prototyping Analyst in Brisbane to develop proofs-of-concept for AI-driven business transformation initiatives. Work with clients to design, build, and demo AI prototypes using GenAI, LLMs, and automation tools.

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Connected Technology Group
jobs.snippet: KPMG Australia's Connected Technology Group is seeking an AI Engineer in Melbourne to design and deliver enterprise AI solutions. Responsibilities include building LLM-powered applications, agentic AI systems, and AI platform components for large-scale client engagements.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Deep Learning Specialist (Computer Vision)
jobs.snippet: Nearmap is hiring a hands-on ML Engineer with expertise in deep learning applied to computer vision at Barangaroo, Sydney. Translate cutting-edge R&D into production-ready CV models for aerial imagery analysis, building detection, and change detection.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Rokt is hiring a Senior ML Engineer in Sydney to work on ecommerce personalisation and real-time decisioning systems serving billions of transactions. Requires significant expertise in both machine learning and software engineering at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist

jobs.title: Data Scientist (AI Visibility & Commerce Analytics)

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst
jobs.snippet: NCS Australia is seeking a Technical Business Analyst in Sydney to support delivery of complex enterprise-scale digital platform and integration initiatives. Bridge business requirements with AI-powered technical solutions for government and enterprise clients.

jobs.title: ML Engineer
